description: Listening edge cases: an empty-string locale identifier is still forwarded to the platform (distinct from an absent locale), partialResults disabled is accepted, and a listen failure thrown by the platform is normalized to a listen-failed error carrying the platform detail even when a locale was supplied.

cases.expected_output:
init result=true invoked=true
listen invoked=true locale=

init result=true invoked=true
listen invoked=true locale=none

init result=true invoked=true
listen error=listen_failed details=Device Listen Failure
